# How to retrieve Ecwid API from the admin panel?

In order to perform an Ecwid migration, merchants will have to provide their store’s API details.

***Remember!** To access the Ecwid API, you should have a paid [Ecwid plan.](https://developers.ecwid.com/api-documentation/api-availability-on-ecwid-plans) (Venture, Business or Unlimited). Merchants on Free plans cannot use Ecwid API.*

So, here it is how you can find this data in the back end of your Ecwid store:

1. Log in to your admin Panel

2. Tap on [this link](https://api-playground.ecwid.com/#!/) to get the access to the data you need.

3. After this, click on the **Connect with Ecwid** button.

![Ecwid API](https://litextension.com/faq/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/ab.png)

4. Then, copy the URL to your personal Postman collection (*number 2*).

It already contains your Store ID and access token.

![Ecwid API](https://litextension.com/faq/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/ac.jpg)5. Then, share that URL with a LitExtension live chat agent (via chat box – available 24/7), and we will provide your ‘Secret Token’ within minutes.

***Note:** If you have problems and cannot access the page with API details from your Admin Panel, contact Ecwid Support Service.*

In case you have any other questions, please reach out to us via:

- [Ticket system](https://litextension.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/signin?return_to=https%3A%2F%2Flitextension.zendesk.com%2Fhc%2Fen-us%2Frequests) (highly recommended)
- Email us at [[email protected]](https://litextension.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#8cefe3e2f8edeff8cce0e5f8e9f4f8e9e2ffe5e3e2a2efe3e1)
